1/*!
2A crate for rendering PDF files.
3
4This crate allows you to render pages of a PDF file into bitmaps. It is supposed to be relatively
5lightweight, since we do not have any dependencies on the GPU. All the rendering happens on the CPU.
6
7The ultimate goal of this crate is to be a *feature-complete* and *performant* PDF rasterizer.
8With that said, we are currently still very far away from reaching that goal: So far, no effort
9has been put into performance optimizations, as we are still working on implementing missing features.
10However, this crate is currently the most comprehensive and feature-complete
11implementation of a PDF rasterizer in pure Rust. This claim is supported by the fact that we currently
12include over 1000 PDF files in our regression test suite. The majority of those have been scraped
13from the `pdf.js` and `PDFBOX` test suites and therefore represent a very large and diverse sample
14of PDF files.
15
16As mentioned, there are still some serious limitations, including lack of support for
17encrypted/password-protected PDF files, blending and isolation, knockout groups as well as a range
18of smaller features such as color key masking. But you should be able to render the vast majority
19of PDF files without too many issues.
20
21## Safety
22This crate forbids unsafe code via a crate-level attribute.
23
24## Examples
25For usage examples, see the [example](https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro/tree/master/hayro/examples) in
26the GitHub repository.
27
28## Cargo features
29This crate has one optional feature:
30- `embed-fonts`: See the description of [`hayro-interpret`](https://docs.rs/hayro-interpret/latest/hayro_interpret/#cargo-features) for more information.
31*/
32

75/// A cache used by the renderer.
76///
77/// Ideally, such a cache should be constructed once per PDF and then reused across
78/// multiple render invocations on the same document.
79#[derive(Clone, Default)]
80pub struct RenderCache<'a> {
81    pub(crate) interpreter_cache: InterpreterCache<'a>,
82    pub(crate) outline_cache: Rc<RefCell<HashMap<u128, Rc<kurbo::BezPath>>>>,
83}
84
85impl<'a> RenderCache<'a> {
86    /// Create a new render cache.
87    pub fn new() -> Self {
88        Self { interpreter_cache: InterpreterCache::new(), outline_cache: Rc::new(RefCell::new(HashMap::new())) }
89    }
90}

92/// PdfCraft patch: replacement colours for the "reading colours" view setting (Acrobat's
93/// "Replace Document Colors"). Solid paints are mapped by luminance: dark paints move towards
94/// `text`, light paints towards `background`. Images, shadings and patterns never pass through
95/// the mapping.
96#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
97pub struct ColorReplacement {
98    /// The sRGB colour that dark paints (low luminance) are mapped towards.
99    pub text: [u8; 3],
100    /// The sRGB colour that light paints (high luminance) are mapped towards.
101    pub background: [u8; 3],
102    /// When `true`, paints with a luminance above 10% are left unchanged, so only near-black
103    /// text and line art is recoloured.
104    pub only_black: bool,
105    /// When `true`, line-art paints are mapped in addition to text paints.
106    pub line_art: bool,
107}
108
109impl ColorReplacement {
110    /// Maps a solid paint colour. `is_text` distinguishes glyph fills/strokes from
111    /// plain path art. Alpha is copied verbatim. Never panics.
112    pub fn map(&self, rgba8: [u8; 4], is_text: bool) -> [u8; 4] {
113        if !is_text && !self.line_art {
114            return rgba8;
115        }
116        let [r, g, b, a] = rgba8;
117        // Luminance of the gamma-encoded sRGB bytes, normalized to `0.0..=1.0`.
118        let t = (0.2126 * f32::from(r) + 0.7152 * f32::from(g) + 0.0722 * f32::from(b)) / 255.0;
119        if self.only_black && t > 0.10 {
120            return rgba8;
121        }
122        let [text_r, text_g, text_b] = self.text;
123        let [background_r, background_g, background_b] = self.background;
124        let channel = |text_ch: u8, background_ch: u8| {
125            let mixed = f32::from(text_ch) * (1.0 - t) + f32::from(background_ch) * t;
126            // The mixture of two channel values with weights summing to one stays within
127            // `0.0..=255.0` up to float noise; the clamp keeps the cast total anyway.
128            mixed.round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8
129        };
130        [channel(text_r, background_r), channel(text_g, background_g), channel(text_b, background_b), a]
131    }
132}

134/// Settings to apply during rendering.
135#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
136pub struct RenderSettings {
137    /// How much the contents should be scaled into the x direction.
138    pub x_scale: f32,
139    /// How much the contents should be scaled into the y direction.
140    pub y_scale: f32,
141    /// The width of the viewport. If this is set to `None`, the width will be chosen
142    /// automatically based on the scale factor and the dimensions of the PDF.
143    pub width: Option<u16>,
144    /// The height of the viewport. If this is set to `None`, the height will be chosen
145    /// automatically based on the scale factor and the dimensions of the PDF.
146    pub height: Option<u16>,
147    /// The background color. Determines the color of the base
148    /// rectangle during rendering to a pixmap.
149    pub bg_color: AlphaColor<Srgb>,
150    /// PdfCraft patch: top-left corner of the rendered region, in device pixels of the scaled
151    /// page. Together with `width`/`height` this renders one tile of a large page.
152    pub x_offset: f32,
153    /// See `x_offset`.
154    pub y_offset: f32,
155    /// PdfCraft patch: when set, solid text and line-art paint colours are remapped while
156    /// rendering; `None` renders exactly as without the patch.
157    pub color_replacement: Option<ColorReplacement>,
158    /// PdfCraft patch (31): the most coverage values the rasterizer keeps for the page; paths
159    /// past it are left out, with `InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated`. `None` keeps as many
160    /// as a strip's index reaches (2^31).
161    pub max_coverage: Option<usize>,
162}
163
164impl Default for RenderSettings {
165    fn default() -> Self {
166        Self {
167            x_scale: 1.0,
168            y_scale: 1.0,
169            width: None,
170            height: None,
171            bg_color: TRANSPARENT,
172            x_offset: 0.0,
173            y_offset: 0.0,
174            color_replacement: None,
175            max_coverage: None,
176        }
177    }
178}

180/// Render the page with the given settings to a pixmap.
181pub fn render<'a>(
182    page: &'a Page<'a>,
183    cache: &RenderCache<'a>,
184    interpreter_settings: &InterpreterSettings,
185    render_settings: &RenderSettings,
186) -> Pixmap {
187    let (pix_width, pix_height) = render_size(page, render_settings);
188    let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(pix_width, pix_height);
189    render_into(page, cache, interpreter_settings, render_settings, pixmap.data_as_u8_slice_mut());
190    pixmap
191}
192
193/// PdfCraft patch: the size in pixels of what [`render`] produces with these settings.
194pub fn render_size(page: &Page<'_>, render_settings: &RenderSettings) -> (u16, u16) {
195    let (width, height) = page.render_dimensions();
196    let (scaled_width, scaled_height) = ((width * render_settings.x_scale) as f64, (height * render_settings.y_scale) as f64);
197    (render_settings.width.unwrap_or(scaled_width.floor() as u16), render_settings.height.unwrap_or(scaled_height.floor() as u16))
198}
199
200/// PdfCraft patch: [`render`] into `buffer`, premultiplied RGBA8 rows of [`render_size`]
201/// pixels, so the caller chooses the allocation (one aligned to whole pixels can then become
202/// texture data without a copy). `buffer.len()` must be width × height × 4; any other length
203/// leaves `buffer` untouched (vello_cpu asserts on the length, and a panic must not be reachable).
204pub fn render_into<'a>(
205    page: &'a Page<'a>,
206    cache: &RenderCache<'a>,
207    interpreter_settings: &InterpreterSettings,
208    render_settings: &RenderSettings,
209    buffer: &mut [u8],
210) {
211    let (x_scale, y_scale) = (render_settings.x_scale, render_settings.y_scale);
212    let initial_transform = Affine::translate((-render_settings.x_offset as f64, -render_settings.y_offset as f64))
213        * Affine::scale_non_uniform(x_scale as f64, y_scale as f64)
214        * page.initial_transform(true).to_kurbo();
215
216    let (pix_width, pix_height) = render_size(page, render_settings);
217    let expected = (pix_width as usize).checked_mul(pix_height as usize).and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(4));
218    if expected != Some(buffer.len()) {
219        return;
220    }
221    let mut state = Context::new(
222        initial_transform,
223        Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, pix_width as f64, pix_height as f64),
224        &cache.interpreter_cache,
225        page.xref(),
226        interpreter_settings.clone(),
227    );
228
229    let vc_settings = crate::third_party::vello_cpu::RenderSettings { level: Level::new(), num_threads: 0, render_mode: RenderMode::OptimizeSpeed };
230
231    let mut device = Renderer::new(pix_width, pix_height, vc_settings, cache, render_settings.color_replacement, interpreter_settings.preview);
232
233    if let Some(max) = render_settings.max_coverage {
234        device.ctx.set_max_coverage(max);
235    }
236
237    // PdfCraft patch (18): the page renders as one transparency group (the page group). Its
238    // objects composite with an initially transparent backdrop, and the group is then put on
239    // the paper (ISO 32000-2, page group), so a blend mode only blends where something was
240    // drawn: a /BM /Screen fill over an empty part of the page keeps its colour (#2970).
241    // Under reading colours the background is painted *inside* the group instead, as its
242    // initial backdrop, so a Multiply highlight blends with the dark background: outside it,
243    // the highlight kept its own flat colour and the words under it vanished into the band
244    // (#1548). Reading colours replace the page's colours anyway; for document colours the
245    // background stays outside, or every separable mode but Normal, Multiply, Darken and
246    // HardLight would blend with the white paper.
247    let backdrop_inside = render_settings.color_replacement.is_some();
248    if backdrop_inside {
249        device.push_transparency_group(1.0, None, BlendMode::Normal);
250    }
251
252    device.ctx.set_paint(render_settings.bg_color);
253    device.ctx.fill_rect(&Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, pix_width as f64, pix_height as f64));
254    let mut clip_path = page.intersected_crop_box().to_kurbo().to_path(0.1);
255    clip_path.apply_affine(initial_transform);
256    device.push_clip_path(&ClipPath { path: clip_path, fill: FillRule::NonZero });
257    if !backdrop_inside {
258        device.push_transparency_group(1.0, None, BlendMode::Normal);
259    }
260
261    interpret_page(page, &mut state, &mut device);
262    // PdfCraft patch (31): what the rasterizer left out once its coverage was full (a page that
263    // paints the same content millions of times over) is content left out, said as such.
264    if device.ctx.coverage_full() {
265        (interpreter_settings.warning_sink)(crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated);
266    }
267
268    if !backdrop_inside {
269        device.pop_transparency_group();
270    }
271    device.pop_clip_path();
272    if backdrop_inside {
273        device.pop_transparency_group();
274    }
275
276    let mut resources = crate::third_party::vello_cpu::Resources::default();
277    device.ctx.render_to_buffer(&mut resources, buffer, pix_width, pix_height, vc_settings.render_mode);
278}

280// Just a convenience method for testing.
281#[doc(hidden)]
282pub fn render_pdf(
283    pdf: &Pdf,
284    scale: f32,
285    settings: InterpreterSettings,
286    color_replacement: Option<ColorReplacement>,
287    range: Option<RangeInclusive<usize>>,
288) -> Option<Vec<Pixmap>> {
289    let cache = RenderCache::new();
290    let rendered = pdf
291        .pages()
292        .iter()
293        .enumerate()
294        .flat_map(|(idx, page)| {
295            if range.clone().is_some_and(|range| !range.contains(&idx)) {
296                return None;
297            }
298
299            let pixmap = render(
300                page,
301                &cache,
302                &settings,
303                &RenderSettings { x_scale: scale, y_scale: scale, bg_color: WHITE, color_replacement, ..Default::default() },
304            );
305
306            Some(pixmap)
307        })
308        .collect();
309
310    Some(rendered)
311}

317// PdfCraft patch: unit tests for the reading-colours mapping.
318#[cfg(any())]
319mod color_replacement_tests {
320    use super::ColorReplacement;
321
322    fn config(text: [u8; 3], background: [u8; 3], only_black: bool, line_art: bool) -> ColorReplacement {
323        ColorReplacement { text, background, only_black, line_art }
324    }
325
326    #[cfg(any())]
327    fn black_maps_to_text_colour() {
328        let r = config([0x12, 0x34, 0x56], [0xff, 0xff, 0xff], false, true);
329        assert_eq!(r.map([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xff], true), [0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0xff]);
330    }
331
332    #[cfg(any())]
333    fn white_maps_to_background() {
334        let r = config([0x00, 0x00, 0x00], [0xab, 0xcd, 0xef], false, true);
335        assert_eq!(r.map([0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff], true), [0xab, 0xcd, 0xef, 0xff]);
336    }
337
338    #[cfg(any())]
339    fn midgrey_interpolates() {
340        // 0x80 grey between black text and a white background lands near 0x80.
341        let r = config([0x00, 0x00, 0x00], [0xff, 0xff, 0xff], false, true);
342        let [mapped_r, mapped_g, mapped_b, mapped_a] = r.map([0x80, 0x80, 0x80, 0xff], true);
343        assert!(mapped_r.abs_diff(0x80) <= 2);
344        assert!(mapped_g.abs_diff(0x80) <= 2);
345        assert!(mapped_b.abs_diff(0x80) <= 2);
346        assert_eq!(mapped_a, 0xff);
347    }
348
349    #[cfg(any())]
350    fn alpha_copied_verbatim() {
351        let r = config([0xff, 0x00, 0x00], [0x00, 0x00, 0xff], false, true);
352        assert_eq!(r.map([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 137], true), [0xff, 0x00, 0x00, 137]);
353        assert_eq!(r.map([0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0], true), [0x00, 0x00, 0xff, 0]);
354    }
355
356    #[cfg(any())]
357    fn only_black_threshold() {
358        // White text on black: a mapped grey v becomes 255 - v, so mapped and skipped
359        // values are distinguishable.
360        let r = config([0xff, 0xff, 0xff], [0x00, 0x00, 0x00], true, true);
361        // Luminance t = 25/255 ≈ 0.098 is just under the 0.10 threshold: mapped.
362        assert_eq!(r.map([25, 25, 25, 255], true), [230, 230, 230, 255]);
363        // Luminance t = 27/255 ≈ 0.106 is just over it: left unchanged.
364        assert_eq!(r.map([27, 27, 27, 255], true), [27, 27, 27, 255]);
365    }
366
367    #[cfg(any())]
368    fn line_art_false_skips_paths_but_not_text() {
369        let r = config([0xff, 0xff, 0xff], [0x00, 0x00, 0x00], false, false);
370        // A plain path fill is left unchanged when line art is off.
371        assert_eq!(r.map([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 255], false), [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 255]);
372        // Text fills/strokes still map.
373        assert_eq!(r.map([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 255], true), [0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 255]);
374    }
375}

377// PdfCraft patch: end-to-end test for the reading-colours renderer hook.
378#[cfg(any())]
379mod color_replacement_render_tests {
380    use super::{ColorReplacement, InterpreterSettings, Pdf, Pixmap, render_pdf};
381    use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::color::{AlphaColor, Srgb};
382
383    /// A one-page 200×100 pt PDF with a white background rect, black Helvetica text,
384    /// a solid red `rg` rect, a CMYK-filled rect and a 4×4 uncompressed `/DeviceRGB`
385    /// image. Byte-level object layout follows `fixture()` in
386    /// `crates/automation/tests/automation.rs`.
387    fn fixture() -> Vec<u8> {
388        let body = "1 1 1 rg 0 0 200 100 re f\n\
389                    0 0 0 rg BT /F1 24 Tf 20 70 Td (HI) Tj ET\n\
390                    1 0 0 rg 20 20 50 40 re f\n\
391                    1 0 0 0 k 100 20 50 40 re f\n\
392                    q 20 0 0 20 160 20 cm /Im0 Do Q";
393        // 16 opaque pure-blue pixels; blue's low luminance makes an (incorrect) mapping
394        // immediately visible as a light grey.
395        let image: Vec<u8> = (0..16).flat_map(|_| [0x00_u8, 0x00, 0xff]).collect();
396
397        let mut objs: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![
398            b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>".to_vec(),
399            b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [4 0 R] /Count 1 /MediaBox [0 0 200 100] >>".to_vec(),
400            b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>".to_vec(),
401            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /Contents 5 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R >> \
402              /XObject << /Im0 6 0 R >> >> >>"
403                .to_vec(),
404            format!("<< /Length {} >>\nstream\n{body}\nendstream", body.len()).into_bytes(),
405        ];
406        let mut image_obj = format!(
407            "<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 4 /Height 4 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB \
408             /BitsPerComponent 8 /Length {} >>\nstream\n",
409            image.len()
410        )
411        .into_bytes();
412        image_obj.extend_from_slice(&image);
413        image_obj.extend_from_slice(b"\nendstream");
414        objs.push(image_obj);
415
416        let mut out = b"%PDF-1.7\n".to_vec();
417        let mut offsets = Vec::new();
418        for (i, o) in objs.iter().enumerate() {
419            offsets.push(out.len());
420            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{} 0 obj\n", i + 1).as_bytes());
421            out.extend_from_slice(o);
422            out.extend_from_slice(b"\nendobj\n");
423        }
424        let xref = out.len();
425        out.extend_from_slice(format!("xref\n0 {}\n0000000000 65535 f \n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
426        for o in offsets {
427            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{o:010} 00000 n \n").as_bytes());
428        }
429        out.extend_from_slice(format!("trailer\n<< /Size {} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
430        out
431    }
432
433    fn replacement(line_art: bool) -> ColorReplacement {
434        ColorReplacement { text: [0xff, 0xff, 0xff], background: [0x00, 0x00, 0x00], only_black: false, line_art }
435    }
436
437    /// A one-page 100×50 pt PDF whose only content is a 4×4 `/ImageMask` stencil (CCITT-style
438    /// line art) painted with the current fill colour, black. Each row's four samples are
439    /// `0011`: under `/Decode [0 1]` a sample value of 0 marks the painted area, so the left
440    /// half of the 40×40 pt image paints and the right half does not.
441    fn stencil_fixture() -> Vec<u8> {
442        let body = "0 0 0 rg q 40 0 0 40 30 5 cm /Im0 Do Q";
443        // Four rows, one byte each (a 4-wide row uses the top nibble): samples 0,0,1,1 —
444        // under Decode [0 1] the zeros paint, so the left half of every row is ink and the
445        // right half is unpainted.
446        let mask: [u8; 4] = [0x30, 0x30, 0x30, 0x30];
447
448        let objs: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![
449            b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>".to_vec(),
450            b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 /MediaBox [0 0 100 50] >>".to_vec(),
451            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 5 0 R >> >> >>".to_vec(),
452            format!("<< /Length {} >>\nstream\n{body}\nendstream", body.len()).into_bytes(),
453            {
454                let mut o = format!(
455                    "<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 4 /Height 4 /ImageMask true \
456                     /BitsPerComponent 1 /Decode [0 1] /Length {} >>\nstream\n",
457                    mask.len()
458                )
459                .into_bytes();
460                o.extend_from_slice(&mask);
461                o.extend_from_slice(b"\nendstream");
462                o
463            },
464        ];
465
466        let mut out = b"%PDF-1.7\n".to_vec();
467        let mut offsets = Vec::new();
468        for (i, o) in objs.iter().enumerate() {
469            offsets.push(out.len());
470            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{} 0 obj\n", i + 1).as_bytes());
471            out.extend_from_slice(o);
472            out.extend_from_slice(b"\nendobj\n");
473        }
474        let xref = out.len();
475        out.extend_from_slice(format!("xref\n0 {}\n0000000000 65535 f \n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
476        for o in offsets {
477            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{o:010} 00000 n \n").as_bytes());
478        }
479        out.extend_from_slice(format!("trailer\n<< /Size {} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
480        out
481    }
482
483    /// Renders the stencil fixture the way the app's render crate drives hayro for a
484    /// white-on-black user: the page clears to `bg` (`RenderSettings.bg_color`) while the
485    /// solid paints go through `color_replacement`. `render_pdf` cannot express the mapped
486    /// clear colour (it always clears white).
487    fn render_stencil_on(bg: AlphaColor<Srgb>, color_replacement: Option<ColorReplacement>) -> Pixmap {
488        use super::{RenderCache, RenderSettings, render};
489
490        let pdf = Pdf::new(stencil_fixture()).unwrap();
491        let cache = RenderCache::new();
492        let settings = RenderSettings { x_scale: 1.0, y_scale: 1.0, bg_color: bg, color_replacement, ..RenderSettings::default() };
493        render(pdf.pages().get(0).expect("the fixture has one page"), &cache, &InterpreterSettings::default(), &settings)
494    }
495
496    fn render(color_replacement: Option<ColorReplacement>) -> Pixmap {
497        let pdf = Pdf::new(fixture()).unwrap();
498        render_pdf(&pdf, 1.0, InterpreterSettings::default(), color_replacement, None).unwrap().remove(0)
499    }
500
501    /// Samples the pixel at (x, y); all fixture content is opaque, so the premultiplied
502    /// value is the straight colour.
503    fn sample(pixmap: &Pixmap, x: u16, y: u16) -> [u8; 4] {
504        let p = pixmap.sample(x, y);
505        [p.r, p.g, p.b, p.a]
506    }
507
508    fn count_pixels(pixmap: &Pixmap, region: (u16, u16, u16, u16), matches: impl Fn([u8; 4]) -> bool) -> u32 {
509        let (x0, y0, x1, y1) = region;
510        let mut count = 0;
511        for y in y0..y1 {
512            for x in x0..x1 {
513                if matches(sample(pixmap, x, y)) {
514                    count += 1;
515                }
516            }
517        }
518        count
519    }
520
521    #[cfg(any())]
522    fn color_replacement_maps_text_and_line_art() {
523        let is_white = |p: [u8; 4]| p == [255, 255, 255, 255];
524        let is_black = |p: [u8; 4]| p == [0, 0, 0, 255];
525
526        let control = render(None);
527        let replaced = render(Some(replacement(true)));
528
529        // Background: the full-page white rect is line art and maps to the
530        // `background` colour exactly (t = 1.0).
531        assert_eq!(sample(&control, 5, 5), [255, 255, 255, 255]);
532        assert_eq!(sample(&replaced, 5, 5), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
533
534        // Text: solid black glyph cores in the control, fully white after replacement.
535        // Region covers the "HI" glyphs (PDF baseline y=70, 24 pt → device y 10..34).
536        let text_region = (16, 10, 56, 34);
537        assert!(count_pixels(&control, text_region, is_black) >= 10);
538        assert!(count_pixels(&replaced, text_region, is_white) >= 10);
539
540        // Red rect: luminance t ≈ 0.2126 maps every channel to 255·(1−t) ≈ 201 (≈0xC9),
541        // a near-white neutral grey.
542        assert_eq!(sample(&control, 45, 60), [255, 0, 0, 255]);
543        let [r, g, b, a] = sample(&replaced, 45, 60);
544        assert!(r.abs_diff(201) <= 4, "red channel {r} not ≈ 201");
545        assert!(g.abs_diff(201) <= 4 && b.abs_diff(201) <= 4, "g/b not ≈ 201: {g}/{b}");
546        assert_eq!(a, 255);
547
548        // CMYK rect (cyan): mapped to a neutral grey that differs from the control
549        // colour, whatever exact value the CMYK→RGB transform produces.
550        let cmyk_control = sample(&control, 125, 60);
551        let cmyk_replaced = sample(&replaced, 125, 60);
552        assert_ne!(cmyk_control[..3], cmyk_replaced[..3]);
553        assert!(
554            (i32::from(cmyk_replaced[0]) - i32::from(cmyk_replaced[1])).abs() <= 2
555                && (i32::from(cmyk_replaced[1]) - i32::from(cmyk_replaced[2])).abs() <= 2,
556            "mapped CMYK not neutral: {cmyk_replaced:?}"
557        );
558        assert_eq!(cmyk_replaced[3], 255);
559
560        // Image pixels pass through untouched, identical to the control render.
561        assert_eq!(sample(&control, 170, 70), [0, 0, 255, 255]);
562        assert_eq!(sample(&replaced, 170, 70), [0, 0, 255, 255]);
563
564        // With line-art replacement off, the red rect and the background rect keep
565        // their original colours while text is still replaced.
566        let no_line_art = render(Some(replacement(false)));
567        assert_eq!(sample(&no_line_art, 45, 60), [255, 0, 0, 255]);
568        assert_eq!(sample(&no_line_art, 5, 5), [255, 255, 255, 255]);
569        assert!(count_pixels(&no_line_art, text_region, is_white) >= 10);
570    }
571
572    /// A stencil mask's ink paints with the mapped solid colour on the mapped background:
573    /// it is line art in disguise, so white-on-black must leave it visible (black ink on
574    /// black would disappear). The image occupies device x 30..70, y 5..45 (PDF 30..70 ×
575    /// 5..45 pt); its left half is painted ink, its right half shows the page background.
576    #[cfg(any())]
577    fn color_replacement_maps_stencil_mask_ink() {
578        use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::color::palette::css::{BLACK, WHITE};
579
580        let control = render_stencil_on(WHITE, None);
581        let replaced = render_stencil_on(BLACK, Some(replacement(true)));
582
583        // Control: the page clears white and the stencil's ink keeps its black fill colour.
584        assert_eq!(sample(&control, 5, 5), [255, 255, 255, 255]);
585        assert_eq!(sample(&control, 40, 25), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
586        // With white-on-black, the background clears black and the ink maps to white: ink
587        // and background stay distinguishable, and each matches its mapped colour exactly.
588        assert_eq!(sample(&replaced, 5, 5), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
589        let ink = sample(&replaced, 40, 25);
590        assert_eq!(ink, [255, 255, 255, 255]);
591        assert_ne!(ink[..3], sample(&replaced, 5, 5)[..3], "ink must differ from the background");
592        // The unpainted right half of the image area shows the mapped background.
593        assert_eq!(sample(&replaced, 60, 25), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
594
595        // The line-art gate holds: with line-art replacement off, the ink keeps its
596        // original colour while the page still clears to the background.
597        let no_line_art = render_stencil_on(BLACK, Some(replacement(false)));
598        assert_eq!(sample(&no_line_art, 5, 5), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
599        assert_eq!(sample(&no_line_art, 40, 25), [0, 0, 0, 255]);
600    }
601}

603/// PdfCraft patch (19): a mesh shading paints its triangles alone (`EncodedShadingPattern::extent`),
604/// and one with no triangle on the canvas paints nothing.
605#[cfg(any())]
606mod mesh_extent_tests {
607    use super::{InterpreterSettings, Pdf, Pixmap, RenderCache, RenderSettings, render};
608    use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::color::palette::css::WHITE;
609
610    /// A one-page 200×200 pt PDF whose content is `body`, with a type 4 (free-form triangle)
611    /// shading `/Sh0`: one red triangle with corners (x0, y0), (x1, y0) and (x0, y1) in user
612    /// space, and an ExtGState `/Half` with 50% alpha.
613    fn fixture(body: &str, (x0, y0, x1, y1): (i32, i32, i32, i32)) -> Vec<u8> {
614        // Three vertices: a flag, x and y (8 bits each, decoded into the ranges) and RGB.
615        let mesh: [u8; 18] = [
616            0, 0, 0, 255, 0, 0, //
617            0, 255, 0, 255, 0, 0, //
618            0, 0, 255, 255, 0, 0,
619        ];
620        let mut objs: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![
621            b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>".to_vec(),
622            b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 /MediaBox [0 0 200 200] >>".to_vec(),
623            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Shading << /Sh0 5 0 R >> \
624              /ExtGState << /Half << /ca 0.5 /CA 0.5 >> >> >> >>"
625                .to_vec(),
626            format!("<< /Length {} >>\nstream\n{body}\nendstream", body.len()).into_bytes(),
627        ];
628        let mut shading = format!(
629            "<< /ShadingType 4 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerCoordinate 8 /BitsPerComponent 8 \
630             /BitsPerFlag 8 /Decode [{x0} {x1} {y0} {y1} 0 1 0 1 0 1] /Length {} >>\nstream\n",
631            mesh.len()
632        )
633        .into_bytes();
634        shading.extend_from_slice(&mesh);
635        shading.extend_from_slice(b"\nendstream");
636        objs.push(shading);
637
638        let mut out = b"%PDF-1.7\n".to_vec();
639        let mut offsets = Vec::new();
640        for (i, o) in objs.iter().enumerate() {
641            offsets.push(out.len());
642            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{} 0 obj\n", i + 1).as_bytes());
643            out.extend_from_slice(o);
644            out.extend_from_slice(b"\nendobj\n");
645        }
646        let xref = out.len();
647        out.extend_from_slice(format!("xref\n0 {}\n0000000000 65535 f \n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
648        for o in offsets {
649            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{o:010} 00000 n \n").as_bytes());
650        }
651        out.extend_from_slice(format!("trailer\n<< /Size {} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n", objs.len() + 1).as_bytes());
652        out
653    }
654
655    fn render_at(pdf: Vec<u8>, scale: f32) -> Pixmap {
656        let pdf = Pdf::new(pdf).unwrap();
657        let cache = RenderCache::new();
658        let settings = RenderSettings { x_scale: scale, y_scale: scale, bg_color: WHITE, ..RenderSettings::default() };
659        render(pdf.pages().get(0).expect("the fixture has one page"), &cache, &InterpreterSettings::default(), &settings)
660    }
661
662    fn px(pixmap: &Pixmap, x: u16, y: u16) -> [u8; 4] {
663        let p = pixmap.sample(x, y);
664        [p.r, p.g, p.b, p.a]
665    }
666
667    fn inked(pixmap: &Pixmap) -> usize {
668        (0..pixmap.height()).flat_map(|y| (0..pixmap.width()).map(move |x| (x, y))).filter(|&(x, y)| px(pixmap, x, y) != [255, 255, 255, 255]).count()
669    }
670
671    /// The triangle (100, 100)–(110, 100)–(100, 110) in a 200 pt page: in device space (y
672    /// down) the pixel (102, 97) is inside it, (108, 91) past its hypotenuse, and the rest of
673    /// the page is nowhere near it.
674    #[cfg(any())]
675    fn a_mesh_paints_its_triangles_alone() {
676        let white = [255, 255, 255, 255];
677        for scale in [1.0_f32, 4.0] {
678            let p = render_at(fixture("/Sh0 sh", (100, 100, 110, 110)), scale);
679            let at = |x: f32, y: f32| ((x * scale) as u16, (y * scale) as u16);
680            let (x, y) = at(102.5, 97.5);
681            assert_eq!(px(&p, x, y), [255, 0, 0, 255], "scale {scale}: inside the triangle");
682            let (x, y) = at(108.5, 91.5);
683            assert_eq!(px(&p, x, y), white, "scale {scale}: past the hypotenuse");
684            let (x, y) = at(150.0, 50.0);
685            assert_eq!(px(&p, x, y), white, "scale {scale}: far from it");
686            let (x, y) = at(10.0, 190.0);
687            assert_eq!(px(&p, x, y), white, "scale {scale}: the texture is not repeated");
688            // A 10 × 10 pt right triangle covers 50 pt²; the sampler counts the pixels whose
689            // corner lies inside it (36 at scale 1, nearer 50 as the scale grows), and nothing
690            // beyond its own bounding box is touched.
691            let area = inked(&p) as f32 / (scale * scale);
692            assert!((30.0..=60.0).contains(&area), "scale {scale}: {area} pt² inked");
693        }
694    }
695
696    /// The alpha of the graphics state still applies: red at 50% over white is pink.
697    #[cfg(any())]
698    fn a_mesh_keeps_the_graphics_state_alpha() {
699        let p = render_at(fixture("/Half gs /Sh0 sh", (100, 100, 110, 110)), 1.0);
700        let [r, g, b, a] = px(&p, 102, 97);
701        assert!(r == 255 && (120..=136).contains(&g) && g == b && a == 255, "{:?}", [r, g, b, a]);
702    }
703
704    /// A mesh whose triangle lies off the canvas paints nothing, and costs no texture.
705    #[cfg(any())]
706    fn a_mesh_off_the_canvas_paints_nothing() {
707        let p = render_at(fixture("/Sh0 sh", (300, 300, 310, 310)), 1.0);
708        assert_eq!(inked(&p), 0);
709        // One straddling the edge paints its part on the canvas.
710        let p = render_at(fixture("/Sh0 sh", (195, 100, 205, 110)), 1.0);
711        assert_eq!(px(&p, 196, 98), [255, 0, 0, 255]);
712        assert_eq!(px(&p, 150, 50), [255, 255, 255, 255]);
713    }
714}
